Complete an algorithm that repeatedly asks customers how many tickets they want, confirms Tickets booked and deducts the quantity when enough remain, otherwise displays Not enough tickets. Continue until no tickets remain. [6]
original_question_summary: Complete repeat-input ticket booking algorithm with availability check
